title: CrossCurve — Business Logic Vulnerability Analysis
loss_raw: $2,760,000 (total ~$3,000,000) — ETH ~$1.3M, ARB ~$1.28M, remainder on other chains
root_cause: Business logic flaw due to missing access control on `expressExecute()` and Axelar gateway validation bypass
